prompt:
Create a production sprite-family sheet derived from the existing reference atlas, for the ONE krogan mercenary at bottom-left of the reference, not Wrex and not any other character. This is a new set of fixed poses for an existing ME1 prototype identity, not an original-game fidelity certificate.

PURPOSE: transparent HD 2D sprites in an orthographic Three.js JRPG battle scene. Preserve the reference's adult realistic proportions, broad heavy krogan silhouette, humped upper back, red-brown ridged head, small amber eyes, weathered olive-green and dark graphite segmented mercenary armour, large shoulder armour, broad three-toed boots, same generic thick science-fiction rifle, and soft light from above-left. Keep the exact same creature identity, armour shapes and colour pattern in every pose. Do not turn the character into a human or make the armour red.

VIEW: fixed front-left three-quarter angle, facing screen-left, camera around chest height with slight downward view, whole subject and weapon visible. Render all four characters at the same native pixel scale; no perspective variation between cells.

OUTPUT: ONE native 1536 by 1024 RGBA image with a truly transparent background, arranged as four isolated drawings in a spacious 2 by 2 sheet. Give each body and long weapon at least 35 transparent pixels of clearance from other drawings and the outer canvas; do not let any outline overlap another cell. No floor, no shadows outside the subject, no gradient, no vignette, no fog, no checkerboard.

Top-left: aim, stable combat stance, both hands on the SAME rifle aiming toward left, feet fully shown.
Top-right: power/action, same mercenary in a distinct braced defensive gesture with one hand held forward and rifle held down in the other hand. It is an ordinary gesture: do not paint a biotic aura, shield bubble, beam, explosion or any effect.
Bottom-left: hit, one clear backwards recoil/impact posture, torso leaning back, balanced legs, rifle still attached to the hands, no wound or blood.
Bottom-right: down, the same whole bulky mercenary lying horizontally on the side, head left and boots right, rifle resting along the body. Preserve the hump, head, both feet and full weapon inside this cell; no arbitrary rotation of the whole sheet.

EXCLUDE: labels, text, borders, inset portraits, extra characters, floating weapons, muzzle flash, particles, energy bubbles, invented accessories, named logos, scenery, cropped limbs and cropped barrel. Make the shape readable at about 100 pixels on-screen. Generate only these four complete fixed poses.
fidelityClaim: Existing prototype identity only; original-game anatomy, costume and equipment are not certified1:1.
